title: Copilot Studio & Agents Watch
blurb: A running record of the Microsoft Learn pages behind Microsoft Copilot Studio and the agents it builds — how agents are billed (message packs, capacity, credit consumption), the agent analytics and agent-evaluation surface that measures agent quality and cost, the admin governance controls (DLP, transcript and sharing controls, agent inventory), and licensing, quotas and data residency. These are the sources the Hub's Agent Evaluator, Studio Agents, and ESS Insights reports depend on.
